Definition: from the base of G1325; a present:--gift.
BiblicalUsage: A gift, what a father gives, and what the ascended Christ gives to His church. Jesus asks how much more the heavenly Father will give good gifts, and especially the Holy Spirit, to those who ask Him. Paul calls the Philippians' offering a gift that abounds to their account, and the ascended Lord gave gifts to men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every good gift comes down from a Father who knows how to give, and the greatest gift is His own Spirit. I ask boldly because He gives freely, and I give freely because I have first received.
